FILE.ROLE: CoAP message 数据模型、动态内存生命周期、option helper 与 code helper

DATA.NAME: COAP_MAX_TOKEN_LEN
DATA.ROLE: CoAP token 最大长度 8 bytes

DATA.NAME: coap_method_t
DATA.ROLE: 当前 server 支持的 request method code

DATA.NAME: coap_option_number_t
DATA.ROLE: 当前实现识别的 option number

DATA.NAME: coap_content_format_t
DATA.ROLE: 当前资源 handler 使用的 Content-Format 值

DATA.NAME: coap_option_t
DATA.ROLE: 解码后的单个 CoAP option，持有 value 动态副本

DATA.NAME: coap_message_t
DATA.ROLE: 统一 CoAP message 对象，保存 header、token、options 与 payload

FIELDS.NAME: options
FIELDS.ROLE: 按 wire order 保存的动态 option 数组

DATA.NAME: coap_bytes_t
DATA.ROLE: 编码结果动态字节缓冲，由 coap_bytes_free 释放

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_init
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将 message 清零并设置 version=1；空指针安全返回

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_reset
INTERFACE.ROLE: 释放所有 option value、option 数组和 payload，再恢复 version=1 的空 message

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_free
INTERFACE.ROLE: 通过 reset 释放 message 所有动态字段并恢复可复用空状态

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool coap_message_set_token(coap_message_t* msg, const uint8_t* token, size_t token_len)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_set_token
INTERFACE.ROLE: 校验 token_len<=8，记录长度并在 token 非空时复制 bytes

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool coap_message_set_payload(coap_message_t* msg, const uint8_t* data, size_t len)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_set_payload
INTERFACE.ROLE: 释放旧 payload；空数据清空 payload，否则分配并复制新 bytes

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_set_payload_string
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将字符串内容作为不含 NUL 的 payload；NULL 表示空 payload

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool coap_message_add_option(coap_message_t* msg, uint16_t number, const uint8_t* value, size_t len)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_add_option
INTERFACE.ROLE: 扩展 option 数组并复制 option value，成功后递增 option_count

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool coap_message_add_option_string(coap_message_t* msg, uint16_t number, const char* s)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_add_option_string
INTERFACE.ROLE: 以字符串 bytes 添加 option；NULL 表示零长度 option

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool coap_message_add_option_uint(coap_message_t* msg, uint16_t number, uint32_t value)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_add_option_uint
INTERFACE.ROLE: 使用最短 big-endian unsigned integer encoding 添加 option；0 编码为零长度

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: bool coap_message_get_uint_option(const coap_message_t* msg, uint16_t number, uint32_t* out)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_get_uint_option
INTERFACE.ROLE: 查找首个匹配 option，并将最长 4-byte big-endian value 解码为 uint32_t

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: char* coap_message_join_options(const coap_message_t* msg, uint16_t number, char sep)
INTERFACE.NAME: coap_message_join_options
INTERFACE.ROLE: 按出现顺序连接匹配 option；无匹配返回新分配空字符串，调用方负责 free

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_make_code
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将 3-bit class 与 5-bit detail 合成为 CoAP code

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_code_class
INTERFACE.ROLE: 提取 CoAP code 的 3-bit class

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_code_detail
INTERFACE.ROLE: 提取 CoAP code 的 5-bit detail

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_code_is_method
INTERFACE.ROLE: 判断 code 是否是 class 0 且 detail 为 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE

INTERFACE.NAME: coap_bytes_free
INTERFACE.ROLE: 释放编码结果 data，并将 data/len 复位

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void* xrealloc(void* p, size_t n)
INTERFACE.NAME: xrealloc
INTERFACE.ROLE: 调用 realloc 调整内部动态数组容量
